title: Variant
description: A single genomic variant detected in the source report. One Variant maps to one FHIR Observation conforming to the Genomics IG 'Genomic Variant' profile (LOINC 69548-6). HGVS coding-DNA notation is the canonical normalization target — even when the source report supplies only a vendor-specific shorthand (e.g., 'EGFR L858R'), the pipeline normalizes to a HGVS string anchored to a specific RefSeq transcript and assembly.

variantId.description: Stable UUID for this variant within this NGS interpretation response. Referenced by CdxFlag, TrialMatch, and Contraindication payloads.

symbol.description: HGNC official gene symbol (e.g., 'EGFR', 'BRCA2', 'KRAS'). Must be the current HGNC symbol; aliases are not accepted.

hgncId.description: HGNC numeric ID prefixed with 'HGNC:' (e.g., 'HGNC:3236' for EGFR).

transcript.description: RefSeq mRNA accession (NM_*) or Ensembl transcript ID (ENST*) used as the reference for HGVS notation. Transcript pinning matters: variant nomenclature is transcript-specific.

hgvsCoding.description: HGVS coding-DNA notation. Transcript prefix is recommended (e.g., 'NM_005228.5:c.2573T>G') and is the canonical form for downstream KB joins, but bare-form 'c.2573T>G' is permitted when the upstream report does not pin a transcript.

hgvsProtein.description: HGVS protein notation when the variant translates (e.g., 'NP_005219.2:p.(Leu858Arg)' fully pinned, or 'p.L858R' bare form as commonly reported by vendors). Optional; not all variants have a protein representation.

hgvsGenomic.description: HGVS genomic notation pinned to a reference assembly contig (e.g., 'NC_000007.13:g.55259515T>G').

assembly.description: Reference assembly underlying the genomic coordinates for this variant.

chromosome.description: Chromosome identifier as reported (with or without 'chr' prefix).

start.description: 1-based start position on the reference assembly.

end.description: 1-based end position on the reference assembly. For SNVs, end == start.

referenceAllele.description: Reference allele string (e.g., 'T'). For deletions, may be longer than 1 nucleotide.

alternateAllele.description: Alternate allele observed in the tumor (e.g., 'G'). For insertions, may be longer than the reference allele.

variantType.description: Variant class. The pipeline normalizes vendor-specific labels to this closed set so downstream consumers can route variants by type without per-vendor parsing.

molecularConsequence.description: Sequence Ontology term describing the variant's molecular consequence on the transcript.

functionalEffect.description: The pipeline's classification of the variant's protein-level functional effect, derived from KB consensus.

variantAlleleFraction.description: Variant allele fraction (0–1). Vendor reports in percent (e.g., 23.8%) are normalized to fraction (0.238).

copyNumber.description: Estimated absolute copy number for CNV calls. For amplifications, typically ≥6; for losses, 0 or 1.

fusionPartner.description: Partner gene for fusion or rearrangement events (e.g., for an EML4-ALK fusion called on the ALK side, fusionPartner='EML4'). Optional for rearrangements where the partner is unknown.

exon.description: Exon number where the variant lies, when applicable.

clinicalSignificance.description: ACMG/AMP-style clinical significance for germline variants and AMP/ASCO/CAP-style oncogenicity for somatic variants. The pipeline reports the consensus from joined KBs.

germlineOrSomatic.description: Origin classification. Tumor-only assays cannot distinguish definitively and report 'unknown' or use heuristic suspicion flags; tumor-normal assays report 'somatic' or 'germline' deterministically.

evidence.description: Evidence-tier metadata used to grade clinical actionability. AMP/ASCO/CAP 2017 (Li MM et al., J Mol Diagn 2017) is the public, citable academic taxonomy carried in the open contract. Implementations that license proprietary level systems populate them in externalLevels keyed by knowledge-base name; the open-source schema does not prescribe values for any particular KB and consumers are responsible for the licensing of any KB they reference.

externalLevels.description: Optional map of proprietary or third-party evidence levels keyed by knowledge-base identifier (e.g., {"civic": "A"}). Use only with appropriate licensing for the referenced knowledge base. The open-source schema does not prescribe values for any particular KB.

sources.description: Knowledge-base records that contributed to this variant's annotation. Each entry references the AuditEnvelope.knowledgeBases array by name.
